selection_notes: One positive domain is included: atlantis-software.net, linked by public incident reporting to malicious node-ipc releases. The account-takeover mechanism is a reported hypothesis, not direct observation.

Two negative controls are long-registered domains with active RDAP records at capture time. A negative label here means a stable-domain control for this small evaluation, not proof the domain has never been involved in an incident.

An Illustria report describing an expired-domain account-recovery path was reviewed, but it does not publicly identify the domain or package and does not document a confirmed malicious release; it is not an evaluable positive. Its page returned HTTP 403 to the direct fetch in this run. https://blog.illustria.io/illustria-discovers-account-takeover-vulnerability-in-a-popular-package-affecting-1000-8aaaf61ebfc4

caveats: N is only three: one hand-selected incident positive and two stable-domain controls; this is not representative of the ecosystem.
Negative controls are not independently proven never-compromised domains.
RDAP values were fetched in October 2026 and applied to the May 13 pre-publish scoring date; no archived May RDAP snapshot was available.
The node-ipc download count is the live npm downloads API window 2026-10-03 through 2026-10-09, not a historical pre-incident count.
Dependents are null/unverified, not zero; the scorer treats null as zero for this measured run.
No historical MX snapshot is included.
